name: Sarah Kline
title: Founder & Lead Stylist
bio: Passionate about gentle handling and breed standard perfection. Sarah opened Pawfect after 8 years working in high-volume salons and decided pets deserved better.

name: Michael Torres
title: Master Groomer
bio: Known for his calm presence with anxious dogs. Mike specializes in large breeds and creative styling. He also trains new groomers across the Front Range.

name: Elena Vargas
title: Feline Specialist
bio: Our resident cat whisperer. Elena has a rare gift for making even the most reluctant cats feel safe and relaxed. She is also a certified cat behaviorist.

name: Patricia Hale
title: Senior Groomer & Massage
bio: The heart of our senior pet program. Patricia brings decades of experience and a gentle touch. She is also trained in canine and feline massage therapy.
